# Reading the Lean PCP proof

> Reading the Lean PCP proof, by Troy Lee, read beside its Lean. Text: Troy Lee, tcs-formalizations at a0ce13e, Apache-2.0.

The links from the text to the Lean, the plain titles, the reading notes and the comparisons were made with AI and have not been reviewed by the authors. No mathematician has reviewed them.

## Read

- [Reading the Lean PCP proof](https://wcook04.github.io/library/pcp/reading-guide/)

## Data

All data is static JSON under https://wcook04.github.io/library/pcp/reading-guide/edition/. Start at edition/index.json: it maps API routes to files.

The Lean index has 5 modules and 65 declarations.
